```{r}
#| label: adams-ancova
#| include: false

adams_var <- c("adams_manic", "adams_depress", "adams_avoid", "adams_anxious",
               "adams_obsess")
adams_label <- c(
  "Manic/Hyperactive Behavior Total", "Depressed Mood Total",
  "Social Avoidance Total", "General Anxiety Total",
  "Obsessive/Compulsive Behavior Total"
)

names(adams_label) = adams_var

# fit ANCOVA models
adams_ancova <- lapply(
  adams_var,
  function(x) fit_ancova(
    dataset = data,
    outcome = x,
    outcome_label = adams_label[x],
    covariates = NULL
  )
)
names(adams_ancova) <- adams_label

# extract tables from fit_ancova output
adams_ancova_summary <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  lapply(
    names(adams_ancova),
    function(x) {
      adams_ancova[[x]]$tbl
    }
  )
)

# Note: Plots will be added in a future iteration
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-adams-ancova
#| tbl-cap: !expr
#|    glue::glue(
#|    "ADAMS - ANCOVA results showing LS means (95% CI) for baseline and 16-week change,
#|    and between-group difference in changes. {data_caption}")

adams_ancova_ft <- adams_ancova_summary |>
  dplyr::select(-contrast_p) |>
  flextable::flextable() |>
  flextable::set_header_labels(
    Outcome = "Outcome",
    n_p = "N",
    baseline_p = "Baseline",
    baseline_p_ci = "95% CI",
    week16_p = "Week 16",
    week16_p_ci = "95% CI",
    p_change = "Change",
    p_change_ci = "95% CI",
    n_m = "N",
    baseline_m = "Baseline",
    baseline_m_ci = "95% CI",
    week16_m = "Week 16",
    week16_m_ci = "95% CI",
    m_change = "Change",
    m_change_ci = "95% CI",
    baseline_contrast_mean = "Baseline Diff",
    baseline_contrast_ci = "95% CI",
    contrast_mean = "Change Diff",
    contrast_ci = "95% CI"
  ) |>
  flextable::add_header_row(
    values = c("", "Placebo", "Metformin", "Between-Group Differences"),
    colwidths = c(1, 7, 7, 4)
  ) |>
  flextable::theme_vanilla() |>
  flextable::align(i = 1, align = "left", part = "header") |>
  flextable::align(i = 2, align = "center", part = "header") |>
  flextable::align(j = 1, align = "left", part = "all") |>
  flextable::vline(j = c(1, 8, 15), part = "all") |>
  flextable::autofit()

adams_ancova_ft
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-adams-ancova-forest
#| fig-cap: !expr
#|    glue::glue(
#|    "ADAMS - Forest plot showing between-group differences in changes. {data_caption}")

adams_ancova_list <- lapply(adams_ancova, function(x) list("fit" = x$fit$fit))

plot_ancova_forest(
  obj = adams_ancova_list,
  labels = adams_label,
  min_mult = 1.1,
  max_mult = 1.1,
  arrow_labs = flipped_labs
)
```
